question: How much does a SaaS MVP build cost?
answer: SaaS MVP builds at Vergentos typically range from £15,000 to £60,000 depending on complexity, AI features, and integration scope. Every engagement is fixed-price and scoped against clear deliverables, so you know exactly what you are getting and when.

question: Can you integrate AI agents into our existing SaaS?
answer: Yes. We embed LLM-powered agents into existing SaaS products with proper authentication, rate limiting, error handling, and cost engineering. Whether using OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or open-source models, AI features ship production-grade, not as demos.

question: Why do you build on Next.js?
answer: Next.js gives the strongest balance of performance, scalability, and developer velocity for SaaS products. Server-side rendering, edge deployment, and a mature React ecosystem mean your platform ships faster and scales further without rebuilding.

question: How does AI integration save my customers time?
answer: AI features inside your SaaS handle the repetitive workflows your customers currently waste time on. Document processing, classification, drafting, summarisation, and customer support automation all run inside your product, freeing users for high-value work that needs human judgement.

question: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
answer: Yes. We offer engineering retainers covering performance monitoring, security patching, feature engineering, and architectural advice as your SaaS scales. Most clients move from build engagements onto retainers as their platform grows.
